lines.2: 「I promised, so I'm going to give it to you straight...」
lines.6: 「This is way too strongly seasoned. Didn't you mess up a bunch of things?」
lines.7: 「To be blunt, it doesn't taste very good.」
lines.11: Not hiding behind flattery is nerve-racking.
lines.12: Yikes. Nagomi's so pretty that she's terrifying when she goes quiet!
lines.16: 「Just as you said, I deliberately got the salt and everything else slightly wrong.」
lines.18: 「I did it on purpose. Your real lunch is over here.」
lines.20: 「Yes. Flattery would have meant failure, and I would never have made you another lunch.」
lines.22: Good thing I thought it through.
lines.23: 「Sheesh. Testing me like that was pretty mean.」
lines.24: 「Of course I tested you. I'm not making these for your sake, Senpai.」
lines.25: 「I only wanted to check that you understood that.」
lines.27: 「Now I know you'll give me a fair opinion.」
lines.28: 「I won't pull anything like this again. I promise.」
lines.31: 「What are you going to do with it?」
lines.32: 「Eat it. Throwing it away would be wrong.」
lines.34: 「I like strongly seasoned food, so I'll be fine.」
lines.35: Nagomi starts eating the test lunch.
lines.36: So she won't let the ingredients go to waste.
lines.37: It looks like she really is serious about this.
lines.38: ...Then I'll make sure I always tell her exactly what I think of the taste.
lines.39: I open the real lunch and put a piece of pork in my mouth.
lines.40: 「Mm. The flavor's soaked right in. This is good.」
lines.41: 「You put peas on top of the rice?」
lines.43: 「That is what the potato salad and lotus root are for as well.」
lines.45: And so we make idle conversation.
lines.46: Apparently even quiet collectors can become boastful when they talk about their collections.
lines.47: Nagomi turns out to be fairly talkative when the subject is cooking.
lines.50: The lunch is genuinely delicious. This really is a sweet deal.
lines.54: 「If you ever miss my rice balls, just say so.」
lines.55: 「Ha ha. (dry laugh) I'm eating them for dinner right now, actually.」
